description: This Java class is a handler within the OpenMRS system that enforces the presence of a non-null and non-empty 'voidReason' when voiding certain domain objects such as Patients, Encounters, Obs, Cohorts, and Orders. It implements validation logic in the handle method to ensure proper void reasons are provided before an object is voided.

classes.name: RequireVoidReasonVoidHandler
classes.description: A handler class that enforces that a void reason must be provided for supported objects before they can be voided.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Validates that the provided voidReason argument is not null or blank; throws IllegalArgumentException if the validation fails.
